wandavoice-desc: Voice-controlled interface for accessible, hands-free wiki navigation and editing, powered by the Wanda extension
apihelp-wandavoice-summary: Interpret a transcribed voice command into a validated list of wiki actions using Wanda's LLM.
apihelp-wandavoice-param-context: Title of the page the user is currently on, for context-aware processing.
apihelp-wandavoice-param-mode: Processing mode: "command", "dictation" or "auto" to detect automatically.
apihelp-wandavoice-param-lang: Language of the voice input (defaults to the wiki content language).
apihelp-wandavoice-param-showthinking: Include the command interpretation steps in the response.
apihelp-wandavoice-example-edit: Interpret a compound edit command with interpretation steps
apihelp-wandavoicetranscribe-summary: Transcribe a short audio clip using the wiki's configured server-side speech-to-text service. Used by the server recognition engine on browsers without the Web Speech API.
apihelp-wandavoicetranscribe-param-audio: Base64-encoded audio data of a single utterance.
apihelp-wandavoicetranscribe-param-mimet: MIME type of the audio data (audio/webm, audio/ogg, audio/mp4, audio/mpeg or audio/wav).
apihelp-wandavoicetranscribe-param-lang: Language of the voice input (defaults to auto-detection).
wandavoice-api-error-disabled: WandaVoice is disabled on this wiki.
wandavoice-api-error-llm-disabled: LLM-based intent recognition is disabled on this wiki. Only local commands are available.
wandavoice-api-error-llm-unavailable: The language model could not be reached. Check the Wanda extension configuration.
wandavoice-api-error-stt-disabled: Server-side speech recognition is not configured on this wiki.
wandavoice-api-error-stt-toolarge: The audio clip is too large.
wandavoice-api-error-stt-badaudio: The audio data is missing, invalid or in an unsupported format.
wandavoice-api-error-stt-failed: The speech-to-text service could not transcribe the audio.
wandavoice-status-idle: Voice control is off. Activate the microphone button to start.
wandavoice-status-wake: Listening — say "$1" to give a command…
wandavoice-status-dictation: Dictation mode: speak to insert text. Say "stop dictation" to finish.
wandavoice-status-unsupported: Speech recognition is not supported by this browser.
wandavoice-help-commands: "Navigate to Main Page" · "Search for quantum physics" · "Open history" · "Edit section 2" · "Make this bold" · "Create heading Ancient Rome" · "Insert link to Paris" · "Add citation needed" · "Create bullet point First item" · "Start dictation" · "Save changes" · "Undo" · "Stop listening"
wandavoice-error-nosupport: Speech recognition is not supported by this browser. Try a Chromium-based browser or Safari.
wandavoice-error-mic-denied: Microphone access was denied. Allow microphone access in the browser settings to use voice control.
wandavoice-error-generic: Something went wrong while processing the voice command.
wandavoice-error-unknown: Sorry, I did not understand that command.
wandavoice-error-noeditor: There is no open editor on this page. Say "edit this page" first.
wandavoice-feedback-dictation-on: Dictation mode on. Speak to insert text.
wandavoice-feedback-resume: Continued the command on this page. Activate the microphone to keep using voice control.
wandavoice-feedback-page-not-found: I could not find a page called $1.
wandavoice-feedback-no-permission: You do not have permission to edit $1.
